desc: Ticket 205 diagnostic: does broadcast TLB invalidation reach every T6040 CPU? Basis: the July 205 oopses are ESR 0x9600004f (EL1 write, FSC 0x0f level-3 permission fault) on linear-map pages whose printed in-memory PTE is WRITABLE (00e8010005f4c707: AP[2]=0, AF, DBM) - the faulting CPU used a stale read-only TLB entry. Kernel patch patches/t6040-tlbi-broadcast-test.patch (kbuild T6040_TLBI_TEST=1, diagnostic only): late_initcall, for every ordered CPU pair A,B x64: A set_memory_ro(vmalloc page) (rodata=full flips the linear alias), B reads alias (caches RO TLB entry), A set_memory_rw (flush_tlb_kernel_range: tlbi vaale1is + dsb ish), B copy_to_kernel_nofault write; failure = stale entry = lost broadcast; control: B local flush + retry must pass; all CPUs flushed locally at the end. Prints T6040-TLBI RESULT. Boot: thin dcuart DTB (no PCIe/SMC/ANS; boots 14 CPUs per 205 round 10) + reviewed 6001 tester initramfs 524d94c3 (keymap; ANS off so it parks), maxcpus=4 then 14, idle=nop. No storage writes, no SPMI/SMC/PCIe. Fresh boot per run; repeat 4x per core count before any conclusion.
